summary_blocks.current_goal: The primary objective was to overhaul the BrocaOS Chat UI and Research Workbench, including a modern Glassmorphism aesthetic, Tailwind 4 integration, and functional backend wiring for memory graph visualization and web search control.
what_we_built: Modernized Chat UI with Glassmorphism design language and Framer Motion animations.
Research Workbench featuring a detailed Metadata Inspector and Artifact Store integration.
Interactive SVG-based Memory Sub-Graph viewer to visualize cognitive linkages.
Functional Web Search toggle with dynamic backend tool-filtering in web_api.py.
Successfully migrated project to Tailwind CSS v4 and resolved complex PostCSS/Vite build conflicts.
constraints: Tailwind 4 integration requires use of @tailwindcss/vite and @tailwindcss/postcss; manual PostCSS config files can cause processing conflicts.
next_steps: Monitor system performance when rendering highly complex or dense memory sub-graphs.
Test 'Source Provenance' display with a wider variety of artifact types (e.g., local database files or specialized documentation).

evidence.claim: Tailwind CSS v4 uses a Vite-first engine where the @tailwindcss/vite plugin handles CSS transformations, making standalone postcss.config.js files potentially redundant or conflicting.
The BrocaOS memory system supports relationship types such as 'elaborates', 'supports', and 'contradicts' for graph traversal.
Removed postcss.config.js from the Broca UI directory.
Implemented dynamic tool-filtering in the web_api.py stream_response generator.
